svg.text: Ch 13 · Design a Search Autocomplete System
Query path (indigo) reads a trie; data path (orange) rebuilds it weekly from logs

g.text: Each keystroke (debounced) sends the current prefix
Look up the prefix node in the trie cache
Top-5 suggestions (pre-computed at the node) return in ~ms
Meanwhile, every search query is logged
Logs are aggregated into (query, frequency) per week
Workers rebuild the trie and store it in the trie DB
Trie cache loads the new snapshot — fresh suggestions
